messages:
jena: Quick heads-up AuroraCloud can list marketplace SKUs in aurora-east-1 but they're gating capacity until we sign the KMS connector MOU and quota entitlements. Proposed soft-launch: Aug 9. Who picks up quota/entitlement?

devon: I can take entitlement. Need SKU IDs, initial reserved vs burst split, and traffic estimates for 45d.

mark (AuroraCloud): We can allocate 6x AU-RTX-40GB and 3x AU-RTX-80GB. SKUs: AU-RTX-40, AU-RTX-80. Expected peak ~50k tokens/min. Quota form: https://auroracloud.partner/quotas/aurora-east (private).

anya: For product mapping suggest 5 reserved / 4 burst. Also note some customers will request private endpoints for telemetry and private VPC peering.

lee (legal): I'll start the marketplace addendum draft. Need Aurora's security questionnaire and KMS responsibilities. ETA 48h after I get questionnaire. Mark, can you upload?

mark (AuroraCloud): Uploaded questionnaire and KMS cert fingerprint: SHA256:4D5A...9F66. We support external KMS via PKCS11 and have HSM-backed custody.

partners-bot: ticket PW-2777 created: "aurora-east marketplace onboarding" linked to INF-5102 and LEG-1234.

jena: Sync Wed 9am PT agenda: 1) entitlement numbers, 2) KMS connector flow & test plan, 3) infra runbook owner + dry-run timing, 4) marketplace copy + legal signoff, 5) partner comms.

devon: I'll submit entitlement with 50k tokens/min and a 25% buffer by EOD Tue.

anya: Infra notes: need AMI bake, subnet peering, and private endpoint for metrics. aurora-east-1 has maintenance windows Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC avoid provisioning then. Recommend cross-AZ fallback.

infra-oncall: I'll take the runbook and schedule a dry-run Mon 07:00 PT. Will post results to INF-5102.

lee (legal): Once questionnaire reviewed, I'll loop in compliance. If KMS custody requires additional clauses, I'll flag them in LEG-1234.

mark (AuroraCloud): Happy to coordinate the cert exchange and KMS test window. We can do connector test Thurs AM.

jena: Please add preread to https://redwood.share/aurora-east/onboard (internal). Gate any PR until LEG-1234 signoff and infra dry-run success.

partners-bot: reminder set for Wed sync 09:00 PT.

devon: ack, will post entitlement ticket number when created.
